title: CYBRIK tool execution (invocation) request v1
description: Request from Cyber AI (or SOC) to the Tool Fabric control plane to invoke a capability (strategy 05 §5.2). Tenant/actor/approval/credential fields carried here are ADVISORY: the control plane derives authoritative tenant/actor from the caller credential and delegation chain, ignores or rejects model-asserted authority, and re-checks authorization at execution time (strategy 05 §11). Idempotency key prevents replay; it is not replay authority after the delegation/approval expires. Status: PROPOSED — NOT ACCEPTED.

action_id.description: Caller-assigned logical action id (e.g. 'act_…'). Correlates request → decision → receipt.

idempotency_key.description: Mandatory for invoke/mutation (strategy 05 §2.1). Same key + same resolved request = same outcome, never a second side effect.

investigation_id.description: Present only for investigation-scoped invocations (ADR-0006 E6).

actor.description: Advisory actor; the control plane derives authoritative actor/tenant from the caller credential. tenant_id required because cross-tenant authorization is evaluated here.

delegation_ref.description: chain_digest of the digest-bound delegation chain authorizing this action. The raw chain/token is never sent inline (ADR-0004 F5).

capability.description: Digest-pinned capability reference. A registry digest mismatch MUST be denied.

arguments.description: Capability-specific arguments, validated against the capability's input_schema_ref. Targets/parameters are re-resolved server-side; client-asserted target identity is not trusted (strategy 05 §11.2).

resource_scope.description: Server-resolvable scope narrowing. Never widens authority beyond the delegation chain.

deadline_seconds.description: Caller deadline; the control plane clamps to the capability's timeout limit.
